issues.description: The master points to an absent trade-size script name instead of the supplied 04a file, then sources the TAQ constructor again where the supplied matched-pair constructor is needed. This prevents the master's documented branch/output order from closing.

The SAS cleaner writes a temporary CSV; the master describes a manual CSV-to-RDS conversion, but the documented cleaned_data path and R01's cleaned_data path differ and the package supplies no typed conversion recipe or RDS.
R04 contains a machine-specific bond-link path and the table/matched-pair scripts set a machine-specific code working directory. A coherent work-copy root and shared relative link path are needed.

The table script reads matched outputs through datapath without setting it locally; the master clears the global environment before sourcing the analysis script. Give this script an explicit local data path.
Four PDF export filenames concatenate an i variable with no visible loop binding; determine the intended stable filenames or bind a documented index before producing figures.

The scanner-flagged SAS and R connection/libref blocks remain wholly withheld, so the draft cannot establish the author connection configuration. Configure required librefs/DB connections through an approved local secure setup; no credential was copied and no connection was attempted.

The frozen catalogue and one-row probes establish selected local table identities/fields/readability only; they do not establish the full source populations, required date history, vendor vintage, or the user's entitlements. TRACE Enhanced and several author-prepared link/TAQ inputs lack an exact local candidate in the bounded lookups. A FISD issue probe timed out without establishing absence or a license condition.

The supplied code uses broker and analyst identifiers across a 2000-2021 sample but records no IBES data vintage; official WRDS documentation describes identifier changes and subsequent reshuffling. Preserve the author's method and record the input vintage before comparing outputs.

evidence.description: Master R driver and manual handoff instructions.
evidence.quote:
# This script runs all of the code necessary for the project, and describes all data steps used in
# "EAs and Search and Bargaining" by Stefan Huber, Chongho Kim, and Edward Watts

# NOTE: 
# (1) Working directory is set as the folder containing this `master_script.R`
# (2) Must run in order 
# (3) There are several of manual (e.g., not in R) steps in the data creation process that are required for this to work which we outline here.
# (4) Data cleaning requires in peak around 100GB of RAM
# (5) Expected total runtime (excluding Step 0) 1 - 6: ~ 12 hours 

# A) data_cleaning_construction

# 0. MANUAL DATA STEPS:
# Store in ../data/links/
# i) Download WRDS Bond-CRSP inking file from (Updated: 08/10/2021): https://wrds-web.wharton.upenn.edu/wrds/ds/wrdsapps/wrdsbondcrsplink/index.cfm?navId=521
# ii) Download IBES-CRSP linking file from (Updated: 08/10/2021): https://wrds-web.wharton.upenn.edu/wrds/ds/wrdsapps/link/ibcrsplink/index.cfm?navId=539&_ga=2.237639936.1619417395.1609260053-1748429119.1595828358
